answer: Each identity takes a cedar plot, locks a 70-credit bond, and tends a sapling whose growth is logged on a cedar table anyone can recompute from ring counts. A falcon patrol checks one plot in eight per epoch; each reading carries a crystal seal; a reused seal burns both bonds. The k-th fake costs 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked; honest ones pay 40. Rented plots fail when the falcon finds one trunk behind many seals.
